I recently had a hair follicle test, studied hard and haven't seen the results yet, but i tried most of the methods I could find online. Maccujo method: vinegar (soak), salicylic acid (soak), laundry detergent (soak), rinse repeat Lemon juice in water Baking soda (soak), vinegar, rinse Repeated these about 15x followed by zydot ultra clean the morning of.

After doing more research I found basic solutions should be used to open the cuticle (so starting with vinegar probably isn't the best plan, acids close the cuticle) and you want to target the next layer down, cortex, where metabolites are stored. Carboxylic acids, which the THC metabolite is, are somewhat soluble in water but longer chains are more soluble in alcohols (sounds similar to the THC molecule, i.e. green dragon).

My thought would be to start with a basic wash. Milk of Magnesia (Magnesium Hydroxide, pH ~10.5) seems to be pretty easy on skin. Could also sub Baking Soda with a pH ~9. After soaking for 30 minutes use a small amount of grain alcohol, not trying to rinse all of the milk of magnesia out but maybe absorb the metabolites. Let that sit for about 30 minutes and then thoroughly scrub with laundry detergent which is also basic. Rinse one last time with milk of magnesia and then with water.

Repeat this as many times as you wish and then use a mild acidic solution to close the cuticle. Possibly vinegar or lemon juice. Maybe use some other product to help repair any damage to the hair, I'm trying a coconut oil soak.

All of these items are relatively cheap: Milk of Magnesia ~$4 750 mL Grain Alcohol ~$18 Not sure if there is a better brand of laundry detergent but I repeatedly saw Tide with the Macujjo method
